lines.text: Peter tells believers to rid themselves of malice and deceit, and to crave pure spiritual milk to grow in salvation.
Believers, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood offering sacrifices through Moses.
Scripture says God lays a chosen and precious cornerstone in Zion, and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.
The stone is precious to believers, but those who do not believe stumble because they disobey the word.
Believers are a chosen people called out of darkness into His marvelous kingdom, and they have now received mercy.
